model.note: Per-country rather than pooled: net position is a balance, DE swings +/-20 GW against EE's +/-1 GW over different borders, and a pooled model would spend its capacity on the country dummy.

groups: own net position: same-hour lags 72/96/120/168h, run-anchored trailing 1/3/7/28d aggregates, 28d hour-of-day climatology
TSO day-ahead load forecast: lags 72/168h + trailing aggregates
TSO day-ahead solar and onshore-wind generation forecast: lags 72/168h
cross-border physical flows: net lag 72h and 96h, plus xb_missing indicator (ABL-74)
neighbour net position (lags 72/168h) and neighbour price (lag 72h), plus own-minus-neighbour price spread
issued weather forecast at the target hour (temperature, wind 10m/100m, shortwave radiation), plus weather_available regime flag
features.serve_time_rule: A run fires 06:00Z on D for all of D+2. Day-ahead-published sources are bounded at D 21:00 (measured, ABL-28); cross-border flows at target-72h (ABL-74); weather admitted only as data_quality='forecast' with forecast_run_time <= run instant. Same-hour lags start at 72h because the binding target hour D+2 23:00 is exactly 50h past the cutoff, so the tempting 48h lag reaches two hours that do not exist at run time.
features.enforced_by: src/challengers/v014_features.py::assert_lag_is_serve_safe, on every lag on every build

training.validation: chronological, last 12% of run days, split on run day never on row; early stopping on validation RMSE
training.missing_values: left NaN and consumed natively by XGBoost. Nothing is imputed: a mean would turn 'we do not know this border's flow' into 'the flow was average'.

refusals: no model file for a country -> raise, never substitute another country's model
fewer than 2 of 3 anchor features present -> NaN for that target hour, dropped rather than stored (GR's condition)
a refused hour is never written as 0.0: a 0 MW net position is a real balanced-border reading

evaluation.head_to_head: scripts/compare_challenger.py, which inner-joins on (country, target hour, vintage). Never compare two per-model eval reports to each other.

purpose: The trained challenger of ABL-24 plan Rev 3 (C2b). V010 is close to affinely optimal per country, so the gate's slope in [0.8, 1.2] is unreachable by any correction layer on it (ABL-68 measured rho 0.41-0.88, needs >= 0.894) - it needs a better model, which is this. Promotion is decided only by the pre-registered gate read in C2c.
